protocol.discrete_choice_only: secondary figure: the same fold scored without the conditional sizing channel (observed raise target removed), i.e. the discrete-choice core alone

metrics.baseline_log_loss_bits_per_decision: same loss under the fit-fold action prior
metrics.brier_score: mean sum over the four actions of (P(action) - 1[observed])^2
metrics.coverage: provisional, predeclared OOD gate: accept a held-out decision iff every single-feature node label of the decision was observed in the fit fold (feature-level in-domain) AND the fit fold saw the decision's exact context signature at least 5 times; coverage is the accepted share of the held-out fold
metrics.expected_calibration_error: equal-count reliability bins per action class (frozen T2 definition of tools/training/validate_hierarchical_validation.py::expected_calibration_error): for each action, sort rows by predicted probability, cut 10 equal-count bins, accumulate bin-mass-weighted |mean predicted - mean observed| and average over the four action classes
metrics.log_loss_bits_per_decision: mean -log2 P(observed action), base-2 bits per decision

no_leak.assertion: assert not (holdout_hands_i & train_hands_i) for every fold i, and assert the holdout hand sets partition the hand universe

selection.justification: selected `regularized_multinomial_spline` from data the architecture was never fitted on: pooled out-of-fold multiclass log loss 1.259893 bits/decision (baseline 1.331896, gain 0.072003), ECE 0.024187, Brier 0.519954, fold-to-fold log-loss stddev 0.004749, runtime complexity rank 1 (253 node cells); runner-up `hierarchical_empirical_bayes_dirichlet` reached 1.278143 bits/decision, ECE 0.037895, stddev 0.006309, rank 2. The decision used TRAIN out-of-fold evidence only; VALIDATION and TEST were not consumed (validation_consumed=false, test_consumed=false).
